transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess my eating has just gotten really off lately. Um... some days I barely get down a coffee and a granola bar before a shift. And I haven't been trying to lose weight, but... my scrubs have been hanging pretty loose on me. So... yeah. That's what brings me in.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No... no, it's not that. I just... I don't really have an appetite. I don't care about the weight.
Have you been feeling persistently sad or down lately?
Yeah... I guess you could say that. Um... most mornings I just wake up with this... heavy feeling. Kind of hollow, I guess. It just feels like the day is already ruined before I even put my badge on.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

I guess so. Um... I used to go for runs over in Van Cortlandt Park, take some photos... play chess with a couple guys from work. But lately, I just... I don't know. I just tell myself there's no point. I usually just end up sitting around the apartment, scrolling on my phone... or looking at my budget spreadsheet. Just... killing time, I guess.
What makes it difficult for you to eat?
I don't really know. Um... I just look at food and... I'm just not hungry. That's all.
How long have you been feeling persistently sad or empty?
Um... I guess the really steady stuff... the sadness and not caring about things... that started later. It's been around for... maybe a year and four months now. Something like that.
Did your loss of appetite start before you began feeling persistently sad or empty?
I'm not really sure. Um... it all just kind of blurs together, I guess. I haven't really kept track of which started first.
During the past year and four months, have you had any period of at least two weeks when you felt like your usual self again, with your mood and interest in things returning?

Um... no. I don't think so. For most of this whole stretch... I've just been living with it. That heavy, hollow feeling. Just... not having any interest in things. It's not like it's just a few bad weeks here and there. It's pretty much just... been there the whole time.
Do you avoid eating because you fear something bad will happen, such as choking or vomiting, or because of the food’s texture, smell, or appearance?
No, it's nothing like that. I just... I just don't have an appetite. That's all.
During this period, have you been feeling unusually tired or low in energy most days?
Yeah. I guess so. Even if I sleep all night... my body just feels heavy. Like I just worked a double shift or something. And by noon... I just can't really focus. I'm just tired.
Before the past year and four months, were you already feeling depressed or empty more often than not?

No, not exactly. I mean... before this long stretch, there was a time when the heavy feeling lifted a bit. I even started running a little again, just... getting through the day easier. But... I don't know. Even then, when my mood was okay, I was still... dealing with other things. For a few weeks, I'd hear people making comments when the hallways were empty. And... I'd keep checking the work schedule because it felt like there were hidden warnings in it... about me. So... it wasn't depression then, just... that other stuff.
Was there a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing those comments or seeing hidden warnings, while you were not feeling depressed or losing interest in things?

Yeah... like I just said. My mood was fine then. I was feeling okay enough to run a little, getting through the day fine. But... yeah, for a few weeks, I was still hearing those things in the hall. And looking at the schedule. So... yeah. It was at least a couple weeks of just that.
During the time you have been feeling depressed, have you also been hearing comments or noticing hidden warnings in things?

Yeah. They don't stop just because I'm feeling down. 

When the heavy feeling is at its worst... the voices are still there. And I still get that feeling that people are tracking my charting at work. So... I'm dealing with both things at the same time during my shifts. It's just... a lot.
For how long altogether have you been hearing voices or feeling that people are tracking your charting?

Um... a while, I guess. It started a few months after they did the shift changes at work. So... probably about a year and eight months ago. That's when the voices and... the signs in the schedule started.
